title: Languages encoded by all-ones strings
statement: For every set $S$ of natural numbers, there is a language $L$ of Boolean strings contained in the language of all-ones strings such that, for every natural number $n$, the length-$n$ all-ones string belongs to $L$ if and only if $n\in S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is an arbitrary set of natural numbers
